comment: Merge-safe publication example. Both aggregate emitters opt in with `merge: true`, so a partial run (--only, disabled jobs, or a failure) keeps everything a previous run published instead of rewriting the bundle from just this run's records. Every job is recorded, so it runs offline with no key. Try: `node bin/mothbake.mjs run --config examples/publish.json --out out/publish` and then re-run with `--only nebula-sky`; bundle.json and baked.mjs still carry the rock tile.
